_about: The v10 guards (Krish, 2026-11-19, habits short, piece 701a2c55): a proof or cut that is visibly worse than what he approved never reaches him. Read by scripts/velib/plainframes.py, called by ve proof and ve render on the RENDERED frames, never the props. It binds every cut not yet shown to him from the day it lands (no binds_from): a rule is met by whatever is shown after it exists. Adding a row for the next fault: add a key here, a function in plainframes.py that reads it, a line in check_frames(), and a test that fails the bad case. Every number is a setting, never a rule of one piece.
enforces: Krish, 2026-11-19: "It has seriously regressed. The subtitles are now in the wrong place and there's loads of black space underneath. I already told you I don't want a plain black screen anywhere."

sample.why: Every beat change is sampled: shortly after it starts, in the middle and shortly before it ends, so a beat that is fine for a second and bare for the rest is seen.

plain_dark.why: A run of rows taller than 120 px (at 1920 high; scaled to the frame) whose mean luma is under 25 and whose row detail (the standard deviation along the row) is under 10 is a plain dark band: ink, black, or ink with a faint texture. Rows carrying a caption or a figure have detail and break the run.

art_directed.mirrors: apps/renderer/src/engine/chrome/ArtDirectedCaption.tsx (ART_REGION, ART, artLayout, cutHeight); tests/ve_plain_frames_test.py holds this copy to those numbers

caption_over_content.why: A caption's drawn box (the art-directed stack as the renderer measures it, else the theme's region) must not sit over bright content. The frame behind a caption is read from the margins either side of the box on the same rows and from the box's own pixels that are not the caption's ink; a captions-off render of the same frame, when given, is read instead.

compare.why: When the engine or a screen asset changed since the proof he last approved, ve proof writes a sheet of the same moments, his approved proof above the new one, and the proof is not sendable until the session records, in the proof's record, what it compared.
